import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    public static boolean checkF(int[] f, int p, int k) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static int generateF(int[] f, int p, int k, int index) {
        if (index == p) {
            return checkF(f, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int val = 0; val < p; val++) {
            f[index] = val;
            total += generateF(f, p, k, index + 1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static long process(int p, int k) {
        long totalCount = 0;
        Set<Integer> visitedIndices = new HashSet<>();
        for (int startIdx = 0; startIdx < p; startIdx++) {
            if (!visitedIndices.contains(startIdx)) {
                totalCount++;
            }
            int currentIdx = startIdx;
            while (!visitedIndices.contains(currentIdx)) {
                visitedIndices.add(currentIdx);
                currentIdx = (currentIdx * k) % p;
            }
        }
        long mod = 1000000007L;
        long exponent = totalCount - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
        return pow(p, exponent, mod);
    }

    public static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        long curr = base % mod;
        long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * curr) % mod;
            }
            curr = (curr * curr) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(process(p, k));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
